programs.name: comp07_book_paired_level_galleries

The soft study target is revised from 2100 to 1500 square metres to fit the legal host without distortion, retaining four 3.6-metre storeys and the same geometry nodes. No required programme is supplied or reduced. Circulation, transfer structure and detailed floor planning remain unverified.

programs.name: comp06_book_turning_section

programs.name: comp07_book_supported_bridge_hall

The soft study target is revised from 1700 to 1400 square metres to fit the legal host without distortion, retaining three 4-metre storeys and the same three-body geometry. No required programme is supplied or reduced. The clear span requires structural and circulation design. Other alternatives retain different heights and densities.

programs.name: comp12_terraced_room_cluster
programs.rationale: Ten occupied volumes form a lower entry court and unequal upper rooms. The upper crossing joins two supports while the other roofs remain exposed as potential terraces. Recessed top rooms preserve the lower pieces as readable bodies. This studies clustered occupation and an elevated shared room rather than repeated decoration. The geometry does not establish doors, stairs, accessible terraces or engineered transfer capacity.

programs.name: comp07_book_offset_interlocking_walls
programs.rationale: A long low ground volume and taller return meet at a thick joint. An offset upper counterwing overlaps the return and projects toward the opposite side, making an asymmetric three-sided exterior room and a clearly different front and rear section. Loads, routes and programme are not inferred from the mass alone. The declared metric schedule and area are a soft authored study proposal, not a supplied programme. Preserve these physical dimensions for this control alternative or report site refusal; other alternatives may test different heights and densities.

programs.name: cluster_courtyard_room_islands
programs.rationale: Two unequal inhabited edges and two low crosspieces hold a central court; upper rooms alternate along the edges and a short upper bridge frames one end, exposing several roof terraces at different positions. The retained offered path is a reference for this authored derivative; execution is the explicit assembly AST, not a claim that the complete reference path was materialized.

programs.name: comp06_book_offset_upper_body
programs.rationale: The upper portion translates horizontally over a retained lower body, producing a visible backspan overlap, overhang and complementary setback. This is sectional displacement; the geometry does not prove engineering feasibility.

programs.name: comp11_offset_bridged_rooms
programs.rationale: Two substantial grounded volumes carry a wide inhabited upper bridge. The bridge shifts along the common bearing axis, leaving an open passage below and exposing different roof terraces on its two supports. One upper room is recessed over a support to keep a readable load path. This is a connected building proposition, not disconnected sculpture; structural transfer and circulation are unverified.
